newsitem.title: UK: Airtours says takeover of Costa completed.
newsitem.headline: Airtours says takeover of Costa completed.

text.p: British holiday group Airtours Plc said Tuesday that its joint 158 million pounds sterling takeover bid with Carnival Corp of the US to acquire Italian cruiseship operator Costa Crociere SpA has been completed.

Airtours and Carnival will own approximately 98.2 percent of the issued ordinary share capital, 93.1 percent of the saving shares and 46.8 percent of the saving share warrants, representing 82.0 percent of the overall authorised share capital of Costa Crociere, Airtours said. It added the offer is expected to formally close by the end of the week.
